scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate && node scripts/deploy.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.dev.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc

DB.description: Stores your sites, their connection keys and the latest updates and comments. Choose a new database for this instance; migrations run automatically during deployment.

SYNC_QUEUE.description: Syncs each site in the background on a schedule, with automatic retries. Use a queue dedicated to this instance.
